results.title: Bibi Blocksberg - Die total verhexte Zeitreise
results.original_title: Bibi Blocksberg - Die total verhexte Zeitreise
results.overview: Actually, Bibi had imagined her school internship would be completely different. Because she missed the scheduled start date, she has to fill in as a museum attendant for two weeks instead. While her friend Marita is doing her internship with the police and Florian is working for the Neustädter Zeitung, it initially seems like Bibi is in for a rather boring time. That changes abruptly when an extremely valuable music box disappears from the museum...

results.title: The Summer in Between
results.overview: A shy scholarship girl enters an elite summer camp and falls into a dangerous love triangle with rich siblings Kris and Kat, awakening feelings she never expected.

results.title: W8ban: Retrouver nos voix
results.overview: Xavier Watso travels across the territory to paint a picture of the situation of indigenous languages, then to find individual and collective solutions to ensure their preservation.

results.title: Never Knew Love Like This Before
results.overview: Manila, 2009. Thirteen-year-old Gino passes his time through television and phone games—until he discovers his father's stash of adult DVDs. When he catches sight of his father flirting with a bar girl in a seedy karaoke joint, Gino begins to question his father's authority and morality. But it's through an unexpected bond through catfishing Giliw, a trans woman from the same nightlife underworld, using his father’s identity, that Gino slowly confronts his longings, boundaries, and the tender confusion of growing up.

results.title: The Playfight
results.overview: Ava and Paul are stuck in a stagnant, competitive relationship when a dinner with a newly infatuated couple sparks an intense power struggle for love and dominance.

results.title: Compost
results.overview: Months after the disappearance of his father, Leonard, 11 years old, discovers a living entity in the compost at the back of the garden. He secretly forms a bond with this thing, which is soon discovered by his little sister. Both start to believe it’s their father. When their mother protests against this idea, Léonard begins to have doubts about her.

results.title: The Father
results.overview: The action takes place during the Great Patriotic War. The protagonist, a Siberian hunter Gavriil Sobinov, volunteers for the front after learning that his son Semyon, a young lieutenant, is missing. Gavriil wants to fights the enemy and find his son, but instead of the front lines, he finds himself in a supply platoon. He proves himself a hero in his very first combat and, after training at the sniper school, gets to the front lines. Gavriil is made commander of the sniper group. He continues the search for his son. The story of a German sniper Werner develops in parallel. He also ends up at the front with his son Dietrich fighting alongside him. A clash between the sniper fathers, whom fate is inexorably bringing together, is inevitable...

results.title: Steakout!
results.overview: Sean's going to a steak dinner. Patrick's going to a stakeout. Unfortunately they're both in the same car.

results.title: Volta
results.overview: A group of young activists orchestrate an unlikely and high-risk operation to force the CEO of a major bank to question his convictions.

results.title: Lifeform 3
results.overview: Zeena's Mother and Sister form a search and rescue mission for her deep in Romulus Woods. However, they soon come face-to-face with the Queen Lifeform in a final showdown.

results.title: The Intervention
results.overview: A woman rushing home to meet a date is blindsided by an unexpected intervention from friends and family, only to discover her bewildered Hinge match has also been roped into it too.

results.title: The Bryce Lee Story
results.overview: When thirteen-year-old Bryce Lee claims to be related to martial arts legend Bruce Lee to gain respect at school, the falsehood threatens to unravel his identity, his friendships, and his self-worth.

results.title: One Hero, The People
results.overview: Adam Bensoltane takes us through the birth of Algerian cinema, in his native country, across the ages, exploring its evolution and its impact on the nation, politics, and the world.

results.title: HANDMEDOWN
results.overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

results.title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
results.original_title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
results.overview: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

results.title: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish
results.overview: Young Jojo suddenly comes into a stack of casino chips worth a million and decides to pay off her runaway father’s debt, asking the down-on-his-luck debt collector Hua to gamble on her behalf. In Macau’s chaotic casinos, they form an unlikely alliance, navigating wins, losses, and life’s challenges together. When the final bet arrives, fate cruelly tests them, stripping them of everything, yet revealing the true gift life has been offering. I Blew Out the Candle Before Making a Wish explores money, family, and responsibility, capturing the shadows and resilience of human nature.

results.title: Let the jury decide
results.overview: After an electoral fraud, a desperate mayor turns to two petty criminals to cover his tracks, but a series of unexpected mistakes puts the entire operation at risk.
